successor_scope: New wet-only generation after the preserved v1/v2/v3 stone-subject rejection; it is not an edit or retry of those images.
intended_runtime_role: nonblocking flat dampness overlay on the land side of the existing Docks quay; it does not replace the shore structure

target_world_envelope_px.placement_domain: inside the existing land-side quay surface near the wharf; exact placement is measured only after actual output review

processing_boundary: Measure the actual RGBA output before any derivative. A later candidate may use one uniform scale and transparent padding that preserves every A>0 pixel. No threshold cleanup, repaint, crop that loses alpha, rotation, mirroring, nonuniform stretch or local redrawing is authorized.
acceptance: genuine RGBA transparency with large clean margin on all four sides and no broad grey halo
one connected flat vertical damp-stain film that reads as moisture absorbed into existing paving
subdued dark grey-blue wetness with restrained thin reflection or no reflection; no bright cyan or cartoon shine
no stone, brick, rock, curb, wall, ledge, raised outline, thickness, cast shadow or separate object silhouette
no new floor rectangle, shoreline structure, water body, foam, moss, prop, NPC, text or collision implication
actual output remains visually plausible at roughly 80–100 by 400 world pixels without hiding the existing quay material
stop_condition: This is the only newly authorized wet-only generation. If actual art still violates the flat-stain contract, wet-shore work remains incomplete and no automatic retry is permitted.
